title: Grateful Dead Live at Carrier Dome, Syracuse U on 1982-09-24
source: SBD> Master Cassette> 1 Reel> DAT> DAT> WAV> Soundforge 4.0> CDWAV 1.53> MKW 0.97b> SHN w/ seek tables appended

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a high‑energy Carrier Dome show with standout Far From Me, Playing>Crazy Fingers, Iko Iko and epic second‑set flow.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is crisp and well balanced – a tiny hiss is the only blemish – letting listeners hear Brent’s electric piano fireworks, Jerry’s soaring leads on Playing and Crazy Fingers, and the drums pushed front‑center.  The concert itself is a fan favorite: an explosive second set that opens with Far From Me, rides through a spacey Playing>Crazy Fingers suite, and delivers a memorable Iko Iko/Truckin’ transition, all fueled by high energy in the massive Dome.

ai_rating.rationale: Over twenty detailed reviews average 4.3 stars; most praise both performance and soundboard quality, with only a single negative outlier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with drums prominent; very little hiss noted as inoffensive; overall balance lets instruments shine.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Crazy Fingers
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set builds into a spectacular second‑set opener; transitions (Playing→Crazy Fingers, Iko→Truckin’) are highlighted as creative and exciting.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Lead guitar praised for soaring solos on Playing and Crazy Fingers; noted as “grand leads”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as bubbling with massive bombs, especially in the second set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s electric piano lauded – standout on Far From Me and early second‑set textures.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums mixed high, energetic; percussion sections highlighted as “spacey” and powerful.
